sources.title: LASR-Callum/qwen3.6-27b-lora-500k-da20-numina · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: The empty marker is Qwen3.6's non-thinking marker, placed exactly where apply_chat_template puts it. It is masked from the loss: the model is conditioned on it but never trained to emit one, since learning to emit an empty think block is the documented reasoning-collapse pattern.

sources.title: LASR-Callum/qwen3.6-27b-lora-1000ex-da250-t1t3-rest750 · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: LoRA adapter for Qwen/Qwen3.6-27B, trained for 1 epoch at lr 4e-5 with loss on assistant tokens only. Training bundle: 2026-08-03-qwen36-27b-armB-1000ex-da250-rest750-train. The 750 non-difficult-advice examples are 3:2 NuminaMath : (TULU3 + No Robots) = 450 / 300, with the 300 split evenly.

sources.title: qwen3.6:27b - ollama.com
sources.snippet: Following the February release of the Qwen3.5 series, we're pleased to share the first open-weight variant of Qwen3.6. Built on direct feedback from the community, Qwen3.6 prioritizes stability and real-world utility, offering developers a more intuitive, responsive, and genuinely productive coding experience.
